in_sanskrit.name: Kanzariya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kanzariya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit term ‘Kan’ meaning ‘knowledge’ and ‘Zari’ meaning ‘Goddess’. This name is associated with the Hindu goddess Saraswati, who is the deity of knowledge, music, and art. The name Kanzariya is a reverential name for the goddess, signifying wisdom and enlightenment.
